- t: ናሁኬ ፡ ተዐውቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘኮነ ፡ ለዘርአ ፡ ሴም ፡ ውእቱ ፨ ፨
- i: So it is known that the kingdom of the Philistines too is of the same kind as that which belonged to the seed of Shem (?).
